items.question: What state is attained by one who reaches the supreme limit of knowledge?
premises: A person reaches the supreme limit of knowledge.
That person becomes dispassionate.
Such a person becomes Śiva.
items.inference: Reaching the highest knowledge and dispassion results in becoming Śiva.
items.plain_english: Dispassionate and having reached the supreme limit of knowledge, he becomes Śiva.

rows.grounds: compound: one endowed with initiation and consecration
compound: distinction of birth or caste

items.question: Why does birth distinction cease for those endowed with initiation and consecration?
premises: A person is endowed with initiation and consecration.
Birth distinction is a social or ritual difference.
Such distinction does not exist in that endowed person.
items.inference: Initiation and consecration remove the relevance of birth distinction.
items.plain_english: In one endowed with initiation and consecration, there is no distinction of birth.

items.question: How are initiated persons of all castes identified with Mahādeva?
premises: Mahādeva is spoken of in a certain way.
Initiated persons belong to various castes.

items.inference: Initiation establishes an identity or equivalence between the initiated and Mahādeva across castes.
items.plain_english: Just as Mahādeva is spoken of, so indeed are the initiated of all castes.

rows.grounds: one born in the lowest class
compound: in the definitive teaching of Kula scripture

premises: Kula scripture gives a definitive teaching.

items.inference: In Kula doctrine, initiation can make even an outcaste foremost.
items.plain_english: In the definitive teaching of the Kula scripture, the outcaste is declared the foremost.

items.question: What treatment is owed to such initiated persons at all times?
premises: Initiated persons hold a special status.
They are to be honored.

items.inference: Initiated persons deserve constant honor and no contempt.
items.plain_english: They are to be honored and never to be disrespected at any time.

rows.grounds: in relation to the spiritual path

items.question: What consequence follows from acting otherwise toward the initiated on the path?
premises: The initiated must be honored on the path.
Acting otherwise violates this rule.
Such violation leads to falling.
items.inference: Disrespecting the initiated causes one to fall from the path.
items.plain_english: But if one acts otherwise on the path, one would become fallen.

rows.grounds: by a qualified or fit person

items.question: What outcome is assured when a worthy person obtains a mantra or teaching?
premises: A worthy person obtains something.
Worthiness supports accomplishment.
The obtained thing succeeds without doubt.
items.inference: What a qualified person receives will certainly be accomplished.
items.plain_english: Whatever is obtained by a worthy person succeeds without doubt.

rows.grounds: compound: by forward and reverse order

items.question: How long does mantra accomplishment take using ascending and descending recitation?

items.inference: Reciting a mantra in forward and reverse order accomplishes it in six months.
items.plain_english: By reciting in ascending and descending order, the mantra is accomplished in six months.

rows.grounds: compound: by order and reverse order

items.question: What recitation practice yields mantra accomplishment within one month?

items.inference: A hundred recitations in order and reverse order accomplish the mantra in a month.
items.plain_english: Having recited the mantra a hundred times in order and reverse, it should become accomplished in a month.

items.plain_english: Doubt is the principle; all arises from that.

items.plain_english: Half the fruit belongs to the doer, and there is no doubt about it.

rows.grounds: compound: even in millions of births

items.question: Can accomplishment be attained by other means over countless births?
premises: Accomplishment is sought.
Other means are considered.

items.inference: Without the proper method, accomplishment is not attained even over countless births.
items.plain_english: Otherwise, accomplishment is not attained even in millions of births.

rows.grounds: compound: contemplation of that supreme purpose

items.plain_english: While contemplating that supreme purpose, one should recite the mantra slowly.

items.plain_english: For one endowed with recitation, meditation, and the like, the mantra is quickly accomplished.

items.plain_english: Afterwards, one should offer oblations into the consecrated fire.

items.plain_english: One should propitiate the circle of Yoginīs according to rule and in full detail.
